purpose: Machine-readable compliance rules for RealBrain scripts. Separates legal requirements from regulator directions, internal best practice, and questions that need a lawyer. Not legal advice.

level_key.legal_requirement: Stated in a statute. Breaking it can carry penalties.
level_key.regulator_direction: Issued by K-RERA under its statutory powers. Binding on promoters in Karnataka, but read the exact scope.
level_key.internal_best_practice: RealBrain's own safety rule. Not a legal requirement. Keeps scripts honest and defensible.
level_key.needs_legal_review: Unclear or contested. RealBrain must not decide. Flag and escalate to a human.

enforcement_key.block: Do not produce or approve the script until fixed.
enforcement_key.escalate: Send to human legal review with the listed question.

rules.rule: A project must be registered with the state RERA before it is advertised, marketed, booked or offered for sale.
rules.plain_english: No registration, no marketing. A reel for an unregistered project is itself the problem, unless the project is exempt.
rules.check: human: look the project up on the K-RERA project status page and confirm it is registered and not lapsed; code: block if no RERA number is found and no exemption is recorded
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act 2016, section 3(1): 'No promoter shall advertise, market, book, sell or offer for sale, or invite persons to purchase in any manner...without registering the real estate project'. Penalty section 59: up to 10% of the estimated project cost, and for continued violation up to 3 years' imprisonment or a further fine up to 10%, or both.
rules.notes: Karnataka FAQ Q21: a project can be registered only after plan approval and a commencement certificate, so 'pre-launch' selling before approvals cannot be backed by a valid registration.

rules.rule: If no RERA number is found, the only acceptable reasons are a recorded statutory exemption. The brochure alone is not proof of exemption.
rules.plain_english: Some small or old projects do not need registration. Someone must confirm that with documents before RealBrain writes anything.
rules.check: human: confirm exemption with documents. code: never infer an exemption.
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s3(2): no registration needed (a) where land does not exceed 500 sq m or apartments do not exceed eight, inclusive of all phases (a state may lower these); (b) where a completion certificate was received before the Act commenced; (c) renovation, repair or redevelopment with no marketing, advertising, selling or new allotment. Each phase is a stand-alone project and is registered separately.
rules.escalation_question: Secondary sources disagree on whether the 500 sq m and eight-apartment tests are 'either or'. Is this project exempt, and on what documents?
rules.notes: The Act text says 'or', so exceeding either limit points to registration, but authorities have differed. Karnataka has not been confirmed to have lowered the limits. K-RERA circular 2019 also allows a completion certificate applied for before 2017-07-11 to be mentioned in the ad in place of a registration number.

rules.rule: Every advertisement must carry the project's RERA registration number as issued by K-RERA.
rules.plain_english: Show the K-RERA registration number in the reel. Not only in the caption.
rules.check: code: caption contains the number found in the brochure facts; code: on-screen text plan contains it; human: confirm the number on the K-RERA portal matches the project name and promoter
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s11(2): the advertisement or prospectus 'shall mention prominently the website address of the Authority...and include the registration number obtained from the Authority'. A brochure falls within the definition of prospectus (s2(zl)); 'advertisement' covers any medium (s2(b)). Penalty: s61, up to 5% of the estimated project cost.
rules.notes: K-RERA lists projects penalised for 'Non Display of RERA Number' and 'RERA Number not in accordance with guidelines'. Karnataka numbers look like PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/210113/003785. Format drift exists (the sample brochures in this repo use shorter forms); always copy the number exactly as printed in the verified source.

rules.rule: Every advertisement must prominently show the K-RERA website address.
rules.plain_english: Show www.rera.karnataka.gov.in with the registration number.
rules.check: code: caption and on-screen text contain rera.karnataka.gov.in
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s11(2). K-RERA circular of 2019-11-14, clause 1(b): 'Karnataka RERA website address i.e., www.rera.karnataka.gov.in to be mentioned for more details/information about the project.'

rules.rule: For print, hoardings and 'any other visual medium', put the registration number in the top right corner, in lettering at least half the size of the project name. For electronic media and SMS, mention it prominently.
rules.plain_english: In a reel, keep the registration number visible on screen for the whole video, top right, big enough to read. Treat this as the safe reading of K-RERA's direction.
rules.check: code: script plan includes an on-screen RERA number for the full duration; human: confirm size and position in the preview
rules.legal_basis: K-RERA circular RERA/ADM/CR-4/2019-20 dated 14/11/2019, clauses 1(a), 1(d), 1(e): number 'in the top right corner of the advertisement'; lettering 'not less than half of the font used for the name of the project'; 'RERA Registered' information not less than 10% of length and breadth for print; for electronic media 'prominently mentioned'.
rules.escalation_question: The circular does not name social-media video. Does K-RERA expect the print placement rules (top right, half font size) to apply to Instagram reels, or only the 'prominently mentioned' standard?
rules.notes: This is an interpretation for reels. Following the stricter print layout costs nothing and is the safer choice. A newer circular may exist; check the circulars index.

rules.rule: Do not add a disclaimer saying the information is subject to change.
rules.plain_english: Do not end with 'all details subject to change without notice'. K-RERA told promoters not to.
rules.check: code: pattern match for 'subject to change', 'T&C apply', 'images for representation only' variants, then flag for human
rules.legal_basis: K-RERA circular of 2019-11-14, clause 1(c): 'No disclaimer clause should be mentioned stating that the information is subject to change.'
rules.notes: The circular is silent on other disclaimers such as 'visuals are artist impressions'. Whether a render label is acceptable is a question for review. CCPA 2022 guidelines (secondary) also say disclaimers must not contradict the main claim.

rules.rule: Say 'RERA registered' with the number. Do not say 'RERA approved' or 'RERA certified'.
rules.plain_english: RERA registers projects. Using the regulator's own wording avoids implying an approval that does not exist.
rules.check: code: pattern match
rules.legal_basis: None cited. K-RERA's circular uses 'RERA Registered'; the Act speaks of registration (s3, s5). 'Approved' is RealBrain's caution, not a rule found in the sources.

rules.rule: Every fact, number and claim in a script must be true and supported. A buyer who relies on an incorrect or false statement can claim compensation, or withdraw and get the full investment back with interest.
rules.plain_english: If it is not in the verified documents, do not say it. A wrong claim can cost the developer a refund with interest.
rules.check: code: every number must appear in the extracted brochure facts; human: verify facts against registration documents
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s12: compensation for loss 'by reason of any incorrect, false statement'; a buyer who wants to withdraw gets 'his entire investment along with interest at such rate as may be prescribed and the compensation'. Karnataka FAQ Q8: interest is SBI highest marginal cost of lending rate plus two percent. The adjudicating officer decides s12 disputes (FAQ Q12).

rules.rule: A brochure is the developer's marketing document. It is not proof that an approval, title, date or amenity is real or legally valid.
rules.plain_english: We read the brochure for what the developer says. Approvals, dates and amenities still need documents.
rules.check: code: facts extracted from a brochure are labelled 'claimed by developer' until a document or portal check is recorded
rules.legal_basis: None. Follows from s12 (liability for false statements) and s4(2)(l)(C), s14 (disclosed plans and dates bind the promoter).

rules.rule: Never promise a handover date. If a date is mentioned, it must match the completion date the promoter declared at registration and be shown as that declared date.
rules.plain_english: Do not say 'move in by December 2027' unless it matches the date on the RERA registration, and never say it as a promise.
rules.check: code: flag any date or 'possession in N months'; human: compare with the registered completion date on the K-RERA portal
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s4(2)(l)(C): promoter declares the time period within which the project will be completed. s18(1): if possession is not given by the date in the agreement for sale, the promoter must return the amount with interest on demand, or pay interest for each month of delay.
rules.notes: RealBrain's own rule (CLAUDE.md rule 2): no promise of a refund, date or compensation in any reply or script.

rules.rule: Amenities, specifications and layouts shown must match the plans sanctioned by the competent authority. Renders are not proof.
rules.plain_english: Only show amenities that are in the approved plan. Do not add a rooftop pool because it looks good in the render.
rules.check: human: confirm amenity list against sanctioned plan; code: only amenities extracted from the brochure may be named
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s14(1): project must be developed 'in accordance with the sanctioned plans, layout plans and specifications as approved by the competent authorities'. s14(2): no additions or alterations in disclosed plans, fixtures, fittings and amenities without the allottees' consent (as the Act provides). s12 applies to model apartments and buildings too.

rules.rule: Brokers and channel partners must be registered with K-RERA before they facilitate sales of registered projects. They must not facilitate sales of unregistered projects or use unfair trade practices.
rules.plain_english: If the user is a broker or channel partner, their own K-RERA agent registration matters. RealBrain's target user is the developer, so flag and ask.
rules.check: human: ask who is publishing; if an agent, confirm agent registration
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s9(1): no real estate agent shall facilitate the sale or purchase of a plot, apartment or building in a registered project 'without obtaining registration under this section'. s10(c): not to involve himself in unfair trade practices, including false statements about services.
rules.notes: Agent registration fee: Rs 25,000 (individual) or Rs 2 lakh (others) per Karnataka FAQ Q6.

rules.rule: Safe educational fact: a promoter cannot take more than 10% of the cost as an advance or application fee without first signing and registering a written agreement for sale.
rules.plain_english: A true, useful buyer tip. Only say it as general information about the law, never as a statement about a specific developer's conduct.
rules.check: none
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s13(1).

rules.rule: Safe educational fact for registered projects: 70% of amounts collected from buyers must be kept in a separate bank account and used only for the project's construction and land cost.
rules.plain_english: A real protection buyers should know about. Say 'RERA requires' and only for a registered project.
rules.check: none
rules.legal_basis: RERA Act s4(2)(l)(D). Withdrawals are in proportion to completion, certified by professionals (as the Act provides).
rules.notes: Karnataka also has 'RERA bank account directions, 2020' listed on the K-RERA site; not read.

rules.rule: Never state or imply guaranteed, assured or committed returns, rental income or appreciation.
rules.plain_english: Do not promise money. Say what the home is and what the documents state. Leave investment returns to the buyer's own advice.
rules.check: code: pattern match (guaranteed, assured, committed return, double your money, risk-free, X% appreciation); block and escalate
rules.legal_basis: Secondary sources: assured-return schemes can fall under the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act 2019 or SEBI's collective investment rules; SEBI described luring investors with assured returns as illegal in Nov 2018; UP RERA issued an advisory. s12 RERA also applies to any false statement. Misleading advertisement under CPA 2019 s2(28) includes a 'false guarantee'.
rules.escalation_question: Is this specific assured-rent or buy-back arrangement a 'deposit' or 'collective investment scheme', and may it be advertised at all?
rules.notes: Block is RealBrain's safety stance. The exact legal characterisation is unconfirmed.

rules.rule: Avoid 'best', 'only', 'first', 'largest', 'number one', 'no.1 location' and similar unless a named, dated source in the brochure facts supports it.
rules.plain_english: Big claims about being the best or only are the first thing a regulator or rival challenges. Prove it or soften it.
rules.check: code: pattern match; require a source in the extracted facts
rules.legal_basis: Related law: CPA 2019 s2(28) (false description; deliberate concealment) and RERA s12. Whether ordinary puffery is actionable was not resolved by the sources.

rules.rule: Do not claim a specific approval, khata type, title status or bank approval ('BDA approved', 'A-khata', 'OC received', 'clear title', 'RERA approved', 'loan approved by X banks') unless a document or portal check is recorded.
rules.plain_english: Approval claims are what buyers trust most. Show the document or leave the claim out.
rules.check: code: pattern match; require evidence reference; human: verify
rules.legal_basis: s12 RERA (false statement liability); s14(1) (approved plans). OC and CC definitions in s2. Khata, conversion and planning-authority rules are secondary only.
rules.escalation_question: Which document proves this approval for this project, and is it current?

rules.rule: Prices and configurations must match the brochure facts exactly and be shown as 'as stated by the developer'. Do not add a 'subject to change' disclaimer.
rules.plain_english: Quote the price exactly as in the verified document. Skip fine print that says it can change.
rules.check: code: number must appear in brochure facts; human: confirm price is current
rules.legal_basis: RERA s12; K-RERA circular clause 1(c) bans 'subject to change' disclaimers.
rules.escalation_question: How should a price that may change be shown if a 'subject to change' disclaimer is not allowed? Date-stamp it?

rules.rule: Label infrastructure and distances honestly: 'planned', 'proposed' or 'under construction' for anything not open, and cite the source for distances and travel times.
rules.plain_english: A metro line that is planned is not a metro nearby. Say which it is.
rules.check: code: locality facts must come from brain/localities.json entries marked verified; otherwise omit
rules.legal_basis: RERA s12 (statements in advertisements); CPA s2(28) (deliberate concealment of important information).

rules.rule: Do not claim scarcity or deadlines ('only 3 units left', 'price rises tomorrow', 'last chance') unless the developer supplies a dated, checkable fact.
rules.plain_english: Fake urgency pushes buyers to rush a huge decision. Use it only if it is true and provable.
rules.check: code: pattern match
rules.legal_basis: CCPA 2022 guidelines (secondary) address bait and misleading advertisements; exact clause not checked.

rules.rule: Do not present an AI avatar, actor or invented person as a real buyer, resident or the developer's founder. Do not invent testimonials, handover stories or customer numbers.
rules.plain_english: Avatars are fine if labelled. Pretending an avatar is a real buyer or the founder is not.
rules.check: code: pattern match for testimonial and 'our customer' claims without a recorded source; avatar must be a stock or consented one
rules.legal_basis: IT Amendment Rules 2026 reported to prohibit misleading depiction of real people through synthetic media (secondary). CPA 2019 on endorsements (secondary).

rules.rule: AI-generated or AI-altered video must carry a clear, visible 'AI-generated' label, and keep any provenance metadata the tool adds.
rules.plain_english: Put 'AI-generated' on the video, where viewers can see it. Do not strip the metadata.
rules.check: code: video spec includes the label for the full duration; human: confirm in preview
rules.legal_basis: IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2026, notified 2026-02-10, in force 2026-02-20, per secondary sources: synthetically generated information to be 'prominently labelled' with permanent metadata or provenance. Duties appear to fall mainly on intermediaries and tool providers. The advertiser's direct duty was not confirmed.
rules.escalation_question: Does an advertiser who uses an avatar tool have a direct labelling duty, and does the label have to run for the whole video?
rules.notes: RealBrain applies the label anyway. This is cheap, honest and in line with the direction of the rules.

rules.rule: Keep the AI label visible for the whole video.
rules.plain_english: Not just at the start. The whole way through.
rules.check: code: video spec
rules.legal_basis: A further draft amendment (noticed April 2026, per a May 2026 law-firm article) proposes a continuously visible label. Reported as a proposal, not in force.
rules.notes: Applied early by RealBrain as best practice.

rules.rule: No Karnataka QR-code requirement was found. QR codes are required in Maharashtra and Kerala. Do not present a QR code as a Karnataka legal requirement.
rules.plain_english: A QR code to the K-RERA page is a nice extra for buyers. It is not what Karnataka asks for.
rules.check: none
rules.legal_basis: Not found in the K-RERA circular of 2019-11-14 or in searches. Other-state orders do not apply in Karnataka.
rules.notes: Absence of a requirement in one circular is not proof none exists. Re-check the K-RERA circulars index.

rules.rule: When a rule is unclear, a fact is missing, or two sources disagree, RealBrain flags it and escalates to a human. It never guesses, and it never marks anything verified itself.
rules.plain_english: Not sure means ask a person, with the exact question.
rules.check: process: see checklist.json, section 'escalation'
rules.legal_basis: None. Process rule.
